message.content: Based on the information provided, Farrah remembers the style of play known as "tiki-taka" associated with Barcelona as "Total football." Specifically, Farrah discusses Pep Guardiola's style of play, mentioning Barcelona's tiki-taka style. No mention is made of Farrah recalling a style of play called "Total football," which is typically associated with Dutch footballer Johan Cruyff and his philosophy, also known as "total football," rather than a style named "Total football."
